annotations.title: Swedish building inspections and compliance calendar

description: Lists the inspections a Swedish apartment building or commercial property must or should have (OVK ventilation check, energy declaration, lift inspection, radon, legionella, fire safety), with interval, legal basis, who may perform it and, when last-done dates are given, whether each is done, due soon or overdue. Free, no account. General information, not legal advice.

has_lift.description: Does the building have a lift?

last_done.description: Date of the last completed check per obligation, YYYY-MM-DD.

ventilation.description: FT_FTX = mechanical supply and exhaust (3-year OVK); F_FX_S = exhaust only or natural draught (6-year OVK).
